q: The Shadowing Lemma for hyperbolic systems states that every pseudo-orbit (approximate orbit) is:
opts: Shadowed (uniformly tracked) by a true orbit
exp: Shadowing: if {xₙ} is a δ-pseudo-orbit (d(f(xₙ),xₙ₊₁)<δ for all n), then for small enough δ there is a true orbit {yₙ} with d(xₙ,yₙ)<ε. This justifies numerical simulation of hyperbolic systems.
